**Verdict: FAIL** on candidate `sha256:089a2a2f…be69` (517 files, source commit `eb8163e2`). One acceptance criterion the assignment treats as mandatory, REQ-PB-031, is not met. Everything else I checked is faithful to the playbook.

Before starting I confirmed the candidate. HEAD was `601bc373`, not `eb8163e2`, but the commits in between only change `docs/delivery/**`. The recomputed candidate ID matched in both the working tree and my disposable clone.

**Findings (ids start at F-DG2-150, as assigned):**

| ID | Severity | Mandatory | Requirement | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-DG2-150 | **Medium** | **yes** | REQ-PB-031 / B0041 | The check "Are explicit exclusions documented?" can never fail. On a saved charter with an empty *Out of scope* it returns `unknown`. A whitespace-only *Out of scope* is accepted and returns `pass`, shown green. The register requires an empty field to fail. |
| F-DG2-151 | Low | no | REQ-PB-017 / B0023 | Gate titles repeat the code in English and Arabic, e.g. "G2 – G2 - Direction". The API names match the playbook exactly; the web pages add the code a second time. |
| F-DG2-152 | Low | no | REQ-S05-003 | The register names `GET …/tom/dimensions/{dim}`, which returns 404 and isn't in the API spec. The feature itself works through `GET …/tom-canvas`. |

I reproduced both earlier observations myself. The first one goes further than reported: whitespace in *Out of scope* actually passes.

**Checks run (disposable clone and databases, synthetic data):**
- **Static checks:** typecheck, build, lint and the contrast check exit 0 on both Node 24.21.0 and Node 22.22.2. `pnpm test` passes 492/492 on both.
- **Integration tests:** 440/440 against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16. The DG1 historical validation passes.
- **Live stack on ports 54978/3977:**
  - The project's P2 browser journey passed 24/24 in English (left-to-right) and Arabic (right-to-left), with no accessibility violations.
  - My own API scenario created a transformation, walked Diagnose → Define → Design, and observed the G1 decision (phase moved to Define) and the G2 decision (phase moved to Design). Submitting gates out of order was refused, and a submitter deciding their own gate got 403.
- **Playbook fidelity:** these texts are word-for-word in the product:
  - the two-mode guidance (B0009)
  - the six governance roles (B0018)
  - the gate questions and evidence lists (B0023)
  - the six diagnostic workstreams (B0029)
  - the five scope sanity questions (B0039–B0043)
  - the ten TOM design questions (B0056)
  - the canvas prompts (B0062)
- **Invariants:** they hold. Branding is labelled provisional and there is no PMI or Mobily certification claim. Product gates state they are unrelated to DG0–DG7. Unquantified value pools carry no zero. Missing fields show Unknown. Money travels as decimal strings.
- **Environmental residuals:** the live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049) are recorded as PASS on the offline/config surface, each with its residual named.

**Written:**
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-2/domain-reviewer.json`: checked against the schema; 26 requirements, 19 checks, all evidence paths exist.
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-2/domain-reviewer.findings.json`: same field layout as the code-security sidecar.
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-2/domain-reviewer.md`: narrative.
- Evidence under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/domain/round-2/`.

**Not done:**
- **Handback not written:** the write guard does not allow my role to write `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-REV-DOM-R2B-domain-reviewer.md`. Its content is in the narrative and in this message. The assignment's handback path conflicts with the reviewer write scope, so the orchestrator should fix one or the other.
- **Misleading log line:** in `live-scenario.log`, one canvas line ("ten boxes") shows FAIL. That was my script misreading the response format; the corrected re-check in `live-canvas.log` shows 10 cells.
- **Leftover background stack:** an early test stack is still running as a background job. It sits in its own sandbox namespace, touches nothing in the repository and stops when its timeout ends. Everything else in scratch has been removed.

I opened the code-security sidecar only after reaching my verdict, to copy its layout. I did not read the dropped earlier domain run.
